audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields describe Zoe setting up 'from stealth' or a 'sneak-attack'; the full layer also calls Zoe 'his' throughout.
audit.why: Zoe has no stealth, camouflage or invisibility anywhere in her kit. What she actually does is throw Sleepy Trouble Bubble out of brush or fog of war. The pronoun error is a straight copy artefact.
audit.corrected: Bubble from the brush or fog, not from stealth; Zoe is 'her'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike, wants.foe[2] and mid all treat Portal Jump as a flank or escape tool that lets her 'portal in from an unexpected angle'.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Blink to a nearby position for 1 second. Then blink back.' It is 575 range on an 11/8/5 second cooldown and always returns her to where she started. It stretches her bubble and star reach; it does not reposition or disengage her.
audit.corrected: Portal Jump extends her reach for one second, then puts her back — it never saves her from a commit.
sources: brief enemyKit R text, range and cooldown

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions were absent: sleep ends a Spirit Rush chain, the first damage that wakes a sleeping target is doubled, and Spell Thief lets Zoe cast your own summoner spells.
audit.why: Sleepy Trouble Bubble is hard CC (18/17/16/15/14s) and its text states the first source of damage breaking the sleep is doubled and that magic resist is reduced while asleep — so armour and MR are not the answer. Spell Thief picks up remnants of enemy summoner spell casts and lets her cast them once herself.
audit.corrected: Never start a dash chain with the bubble up; body-block it with a minion; and know that a Flash burnt near her arms her with it.
sources: brief missingInteractions rules dash-denied and resistances-invalidated
brief enemyKit E and W text

edits.before: Zoe's Paddle Star has more range than your Orb of Deception, and if she lands a bubble on you from a bush or minion wave, she chains a full combo that can delete you from nearly full HP at levels 1-3. Play very carefully around brush timers and never walk up without vision — she wins any 50/50 poke exchange and the sleep-into-burst kill threat is real all the way through level 5. Ward proactively and don't extend past minions even to trade Orb of Deception.
edits.after: Paddle Star's cast range is 800, but she redirects it in flight and it hits hardest after a long straight run, so her poke reaches past your orb and grows with distance. Land a bubble on you from a bush and she chains a combo that deletes you from near-full health at 1-3. Play around brush timers and never walk up without vision. Remember Spell Thief too: burn Flash where she can reach the remnant and you have handed her one.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 remain close to even as your own combo starts coming online and she has to actually land the bubble rather than just poke — both of you are trading skillshots with real but not overwhelming damage. Her ult gives her pick potential from unusual angles, so keep vision up on flanks, but neither side can force a guaranteed kill in this window as long as you're not caught out of position. This is where patience and dodging her bubble matter more than out-damaging her.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 even out as your combo comes online and she has to actually land the bubble instead of just poking. Portal Jump is 575 range and returns her after one second, so read it as a fake-out and extra bubble reach, never a flank. Sleep is hard CC and will catch you mid Spirit Rush and end the dash chain, so never open a commit while the bubble is up. Keep vision, dodge, and let patience beat damage here.

edits.before: Once you finish your first burst item, the matchup flips hard in your favor — Zoe is squishy with no defensive tools beyond her bubble and portal-jump, and your Charm-Orb-Fox Fire combo kills her before she can react if she doesn't land sleep first. In teamfights she needs a perfect stealth pick to matter; otherwise you simply burst her down at range. Respect her all-in from brush but otherwise you out-scale and out-fight her completely in the late game.
edits.after: Once your first burst item lands the matchup flips hard — Zoe is squishy with no defensive tool but the bubble and a 575-range blink that returns her where she stood, and Charm into Orb and Fox-Fire kills her before she reacts if sleep has not landed. In fights she needs a perfect bubble out of the fog to matter; otherwise you burst her at range. Respect the brush all-in and you out-fight her completely.

notes: Three classes of error fixed. (1) Zoe was repeatedly described as attacking 'from stealth' — she has no stealth in her kit; corrected to brush and fog. (2) Portal Jump was written as a flank and disengage tool; Riot's text is a 575-range blink that returns her after one second, so it extends reach and never escapes. (3) The full layer referred to Zoe as 'his' in tldr, report[0], report[9] and a dosFull title — corrected. Spell Thief was never mentioned anywhere despite letting her cast your own summoner spells; it is now in early. The derived 'terrain' flag on Sleepy Trouble Bubble contradicts Riot's description (a drowsy/sleep debuff, no terrain) and was not used. Level chart disagreed on five of seven rows; fixed on the full layer as one atomic group, and the two early phase whys were rewritten because they described Ahri poke on rows the chart gives to Zoe.
